common_mistakes: Submitting the TI as only a building permit and forgetting separate plumbing, mechanical
Starting demolition or rough-in before the commercial permit is issued and posted
Failing to include x-ray room shielding, dedicated electrical requirements, or equipment cut sheets in the first plan submittal
Understating the project valuation to try to avoid the valuation-based commercial fee structure
Not coordinating ventilation and exhaust for kennels early, which causes plan review corrections and rework
verifier paperwork out of the permit package.
Using ordinary office HVAC assumptions instead of confirming ventilation, exhaust, pressure relationships, filtration, and infection-control needs for procedure/sterilization/lab rooms.

response_body.inspection_booking: Schedule inspections through the Anchorage Accela portal: Phone: (907) 343-8211. For commercial TI work, book each trade inspection separately and do not cover work until rough inspections pass. Advance notice is typically at least 24 hours; for a project this size, plan ahead because plan-review corrections can delay inspection availability.

pro_tips: For a $350,000 Anchorage commercial TI, build the permit valuation carefully because the building permit fee is valuation-based over $40,000 at $0.009 × valuation.
Submit the full MEP package together with the architectural TI set so plan review does not bounce the job between disciplines.
If the x-ray room has shielding or special electrical requirements, get the equipment vendor's stamped specs before submittal; that is where these jobs usually stall.
Check the tenant space's existing occupancy and egress corrections.
Use the Accela portal for intake and keep the permit number handy for inspection scheduling so trade inspections can be booked without delay.
health/licensing reviewer before submitting so room names, fixture schedules, ventilation, and equipment utility loads match.
verify B vs I-2/ambulatory-care status with the building department if any procedure, sedation, recovery, or self-preservation issue exists.
